events.evidence: A ceasefire to military operations in the 2011–2012 Syrian uprising comes into effect
Agence France-Presse reports that the military of Guinea-Bissau have staged a coup against the civilian government
Sony Corp announces plans to cut 10,000 jobs around the world to reduce costs and return the company to profitability

label.note: Syria ceasefire is positive, offset by Guinea-Bissau coup and corporate job cuts.
